cases.title: Retry Budget

input.request: Harden a service that retries transient upstream failures.

cases.expected_output: Retries are bounded, jittered, idempotent, and constrained by an end-to-end deadline.
automated_checks: retry count and deadline tests pass
human_review_rubric: backoff does not hide permanent failure
success_criteria: Required outcome: Retries are bounded, jittered, idempotent, and constrained by an end-to-end deadline.
Verification requirement: retry count and deadline tests pass
Verification requirement: retry storm path is simulated

cases.title: Restore Drill

input.request: Rehearse recovery from a corrupted derived data store.

cases.expected_output: Restore/rebuild completes in isolation and measured recovery objective is reported.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Restore/rebuild completes in isolation and measured recovery objective is reported.
Verification requirement: restore drill artifacts retained

cases.title: Degraded Mode

input.request: Operate when a non-critical dependency is unavailable.

cases.expected_output: Critical user paths remain safe while degraded behavior is visible and reversible.
automated_checks: health and alert states are asserted
success_criteria: Required outcome: Critical user paths remain safe while degraded behavior is visible and reversible.
Verification requirement: dependency fault injection passes
Verification requirement: health and alert states are asserted
